ThingDef.label: safe reserve battery
ThingDef.description: Stores 3600 Wd at 100% charging efficiency. While connected, charges from surplus grid power and supplies shortages like an ordinary battery. It cannot short circuit, and grid short circuits cannot drain its reserve, even while connected. Disconnect it to protect its reserve from grid demand and weapons drawing from the grid; reconnect when needed. The charge bar shows stored energy. Cyan-gray panels indicate an actual grid connection; neutral gray indicates isolation or no connection. Starts empty and connected. Self-discharges at 5 W even while disconnected.
